page_title: PIS 0-0 FIO | Pisa v Fiorentina 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
90+1' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fiorentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90' Edin Dzeko (Fiorentina) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
87' Substitution. Edin Dzeko (Fiorentina) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jacopo Fazzini walks off.
87' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Matteo Tramoni will be replaced by Stefano Moreo (Pisa).
84' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.

84' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) is going to have a crack himself.
84' Gianluca Manganiello interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Dodo (Fiorentina).
82' A corner kick by Pisa is thwarted by the well prepared David de Gea (Fiorentina).
80' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal!
80' Stefano Pioli prepares a substitution. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia is replaced by Simon Sohm (Fiorentina).

76' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the bottom right corner. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Adrian Semper with a fabulous save.
76' Fiorentina win a corner.
74' Here comes a substitution. Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Albert Gudmundsson.
74' The goal by Pisa is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
73' Wait! Referee Gianluca Manganiello has indicated he is going to review the Pisa goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.

71' What a beautiful moment! Henrik Meister (Pisa) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. David de Gea just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
68' A substitution has been made. M'Bala Nzola goes off and Henrik Meister (Pisa) comes on.
67' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Marius Marin and he is replaced by Isak Vural (Pisa).
67' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris.
66' The VAR intervenes and the referee disallows the goal as Moise Kean (Fiorentina) was in an offside position!
60' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
57' After what seems an eternity, referee Gianluca Manganiello decides there was an offside after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL for Fiorentina, play to continue.
57' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Fiorentina can stand using VAR.
56' A cross from a corner kick by Fiorentina is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
53' The corner is swung in but Pisa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
52' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for David de Gea as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
49' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
48' Alberto Gilardino is forced to make a change. Michel Aebischer is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Malthe Hojholt (Pisa).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Gianluca Manganiello has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
45+2' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' The shot by Moise Kean (Fiorentina) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Adrian Semper.
42' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) attempts to discuss the decision with Gianluca Manganiello, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
39' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Idrissa Toure (Pisa), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
39' The linesman referee is pointing towards the corner flag. It will be a corner kick.
39' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
39' Fiorentina take a short corner kick.

37' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Robin Gosens (Fiorentina), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
35' CHANCE! Dodo finds Moise Kean (Fiorentina) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post!
34' Adrian Semper steps in and intercepts a long pass from Robin Gosens (Fiorentina).

28' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) drills his free kick effort towards the bottom left corner, but Adrian Semper is well prepared and makes a good block to stop the ball from crossing the goal line.
27' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
27' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.

24' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch. Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
22' Dodo (Fiorentina) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
17' Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
13' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) latches on to a nice cross and directs a header at goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball only hits the crossbar.
12' None of the Pisa players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
8' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) fires a first-time shot. Unfortunately for him, his strike goes a few inches wide of the left post.
6' Pisa take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
